text:
Palladium Price in 2014
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2014, the LBMA palladium price rose 14.7% between 2014-01-31 ($707) and 2014-12-30 ($811). The highest sampled price was $898 in August and the lowest was $707 in January. The mean of these observations was $806. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
